description: This file defines an interface class IOmiProxy within the 'omi' namespace. The interface provides method declarations for managing crypted bundles (mounting and unmounting), as well as for registering and unregistering error listeners. It is intended for use as a proxy wrapper around an omi_dbus_api to facilitate simplified interactions and signal handling in a larger system.

classes.name: IOmiProxy
classes.description: An interface class providing methods for managing crypted bundles and error signal registration, designed to be implemented by concrete classes interacting with omi_dbus_api.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given its ID and file paths, returning the bundle path on success.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle based on its ID.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback and returns a listener ID.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered error listener by its ID.

ctags.name: OmiErrorListener
ctags.pattern: /^    typedef std::function<void(const std::string&, ErrorType, const void*)> OmiErrorListener;$/
